people.name: Cyrus
people.line: Persian Emperor who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

people.name: Darius
people.line: Mede who became Emperor over Babylon

people.name: Persia
people.line: An empire that ruled over the exiled Jews

translations.web: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
